summary: In a Form 6-K, Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. reported that Nasdaq notified it on September 3, 2026, of regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (5550(a)(2)). Previously deficient since January 2026, the company received an extended compliance period after failing initial cure by July 28, 2026. From August 20 to September 2, 2026, its shares closed at $1.00 or higher for ten consecutive days, curing the deficiency. All listing standards are now met, and the matter is closed. What to watch: future liquidity and bid-price maintenance.
